name: Beware your desires
source:
You'll take on the role of a 19-year-old boy who moves to America to start a new life.
You will temporarily stay with your mother's friend Kate.
Kate lives in a big, beautiful house with her daughters Christina and Lana and her boyfriend Jacob.
She helps you settle into your new place and find a job.
But all of the main character's plans fall apart after he gets into a serious car accident, after which he finds himself between the world of the living and the dead.​
